qe:
Select the most appropriate one-word substitution for:
That which cannot be avoided
qh:
दिए गए शब्द समूह के लिए एक शब्द चुनिए:
That which cannot be avoided
e: 'Inevitable' means certain to happen and unavoidable.

qe:
Select the most appropriate one-word substitution for:
A place where birds are kept
qh:
दिए गए शब्द समूह के लिए एक शब्द चुनिए:
A place where birds are kept
e: An 'aviary' is a large enclosure for keeping birds; an 'apiary' is for bees.

qe:
Select the most appropriate one-word substitution for:
One who believes in the existence of God
qh:
दिए गए शब्द समूह के लिए एक शब्द चुनिए:
One who believes in the existence of God
e: A 'theist' believes in the existence of God; an 'atheist' does not.

qe:
Select the most appropriate one-word substitution for:
A person who is new to a profession or activity
qh:
दिए गए शब्द समूह के लिए एक शब्द चुनिए:
A person who is new to a profession or activity
e: A 'novice' is a beginner or someone inexperienced in a skill or job.

qe: Choose the word closest in meaning (Synonym) to: ADVERSITY
qh: दिए गए शब्द का समानार्थी (Synonym) चुनिए: ADVERSITY
e: 'Adversity' means a difficult or unpleasant situation ('Misfortune').

qe: Choose the word closest in meaning (Synonym) to: AMIABLE
qh: दिए गए शब्द का समानार्थी (Synonym) चुनिए: AMIABLE
e: 'Amiable' means having a friendly and pleasant manner.

qe: Choose the word closest in meaning (Synonym) to: TRANSIENT
qh: दिए गए शब्द का समानार्थी (Synonym) चुनिए: TRANSIENT
e: 'Transient' means lasting only for a short time ('Temporary').

qe: Choose the word opposite in meaning (Antonym) to: MANDATORY
qh: दिए गए शब्द का विलोम शब्द (Antonym) चुनिए: MANDATORY
e: 'Mandatory' means required by rule; 'Optional' means left to personal choice.

qe: Choose the word opposite in meaning (Antonym) to: VIVID
qh: दिए गए शब्द का विलोम शब्द (Antonym) चुनिए: VIVID
e: 'Vivid' means bright, clear, and intense; 'Faint' means weak or unclear.

qe: Choose the word opposite in meaning (Antonym) to: OPTIMISTIC
qh: दिए गए शब्द का विलोम शब्द (Antonym) चुनिए: OPTIMISTIC
e: 'Optimistic' means hopeful; 'Pessimistic' means tending to expect the worst.

qe:
Select the meaning of the idiom:
Under the weather
qh:
दिए गए मुहावरे का सही अर्थ चुनिए:
Under the weather
e: 'Under the weather' means feeling sick or in low spirits.

qe:
Select the meaning of the idiom:
To leave no stone unturned
qh:
दिए गए मुहावरे का सही अर्थ चुनिए:
To leave no stone unturned
e: 'Leave no stone unturned' means to try every possible way to achieve something.

qe:
Select the meaning of the idiom:
To cut corners
qh:
दिए गए मुहावरे का सही अर्थ चुनिए:
To cut corners
oe: To do something cheaply or carelessly to save time/money
oh: To do something cheaply or carelessly to save time/money
e: 'Cut corners' means to skip important steps in order to save time, money, or effort, often reducing quality.

qe:
Fill in the blank:
The train arrived ______ the platform exactly on time.
qh:
रिक्त स्थान भरिए:
The train arrived ______ the platform exactly on time.
e: 'Arrive at' is used for specific points/places such as a station or platform.

qe:
Fill in the blank:
Slow and steady ______ the race.
qh:
रिक्त स्थान भरिए:
Slow and steady ______ the race.
e: 'Slow and steady' represents one combined idea, taking the singular verb 'wins'.

qe:
Fill in the blank:
He gave ______ smoking on his doctor's advice.
qh:
रिक्त स्थान भरिए:
He gave ______ smoking on his doctor's advice.
e: 'Give up' means to quit a habit.

qe:
Fill in the blank:
The book comprises ______ ten detailed chapters.
qh:
रिक्त स्थान भरिए:
The book comprises ______ ten detailed chapters.
e: In active voice, 'comprise' means 'consist of' and takes NO preposition directly after it.

qe:
Fill in the blank:
She is the ______ intelligent girl in the entire college.
qh:
रिक्त स्थान भरिए:
She is the ______ intelligent girl in the entire college.
e: Superlative degree preceded by 'the' requires 'most intelligent'.

qe:
Fill in the blank:
Bread and butter ______ his usual breakfast.
qh:
रिक्त स्थान भरिए:
Bread and butter ______ his usual breakfast.
e: 'Bread and butter' refers to a single dish/breakfast item, so singular 'is' is correct.

qe:
Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error:
The cattles were (A) / grazing in (B) / the green meadow. (C) / No error (D)
qh:
वाक्य के किस भाग में व्याकरणिक त्रुटि है, पहचानिए:
The cattles were (A) / grazing in (B) / the green meadow. (C) / No error (D)
e: 'Cattle' is already a plural noun and never takes '-s'; write 'The cattle were'.

qe:
Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error:
It is high time (A) / we start (B) / preparing seriously. (C) / No error (D)
qh:
वाक्य के किस भाग में व्याकरणिक त्रुटि है, पहचानिए:
It is high time (A) / we start (B) / preparing seriously. (C) / No error (D)
e: 'It is high time + subject' takes the past simple verb: 'we started'.

qe:
Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error:
Between you and I, (A) / the plan seems (B) / very risky. (C) / No error (D)
qh:
वाक्य के किस भाग में व्याकरणिक त्रुटि है, पहचानिए:
Between you and I, (A) / the plan seems (B) / very risky. (C) / No error (D)
e: Prepositions take objective pronouns: 'Between you and me'.

qe:
Improve the bracketed part:
He is (addicted with) playing video games.
qh:
कोष्ठक में दिए गए भाग को सुधारिए:
He is (addicted with) playing video games.
e: 'Addicted' always takes the preposition 'to'.

qe:
Convert into Passive Voice:
Shut the door.
qh:
दिए गए वाक्य को Passive Voice में बदलिए:
Shut the door.
oe: The door is shut by you.
oh: The door is shut by you.
e: Imperative commands convert to 'Let + object + be + V3' ('Let the door be shut').

qe:
Convert into Indirect Speech:
Anil said to his friend, "Please lend me your pen."
qh:
दिए गए वाक्य को Indirect Speech में बदलिए:
Anil said to his friend, "Please lend me your pen."
oe: Anil ordered his friend to lend him his pen.
Anil requested his friend to lend him his pen.
Anil asked his friend lend me your pen.
Anil requested his friend that lend him his pen.
oh: Anil ordered his friend to lend him his pen.
Anil requested his friend to lend him his pen.
Anil asked his friend lend me your pen.
Anil requested his friend that lend him his pen.
e: Requests with 'Please' convert to 'requested + object + to + V1'.

qe: Pick the correctly spelt word from the given choices:
qh: दिए गए विकल्पों में से सही वर्तनी वाला शब्द चुनिए:
e: 'Bureaucracy' is spelt B-U-R-E-A-U-C-R-A-C-Y.

qe:
Read the passage and fill in blank (1):
Water conservation has become an urgent (1)____ in both rural and urban areas. Farmers are adopting drip irrigation to (2)____ wastage while nourishing crops effectively. Similarly, households can save thousands of litres annually by fixing leaking taps and (3)____ rainwater during the (4)____ season.
qh:
गद्यांश को पढ़कर रिक्त स्थान (1) की पूर्ति कीजिए:
Water conservation has become an urgent (1)____ in both rural and urban areas. Farmers are adopting drip irrigation to (2)____ wastage while nourishing crops effectively. Similarly, households can save thousands of litres annually by fixing leaking taps and (3)____ rainwater during the (4)____ season.
e: Water conservation is an urgent 'necessity'.

qe:
Read the passage and fill in blank (2):
Water conservation has become an urgent (1)____ in both rural and urban areas. Farmers are adopting drip irrigation to (2)____ wastage while nourishing crops effectively. Similarly, households can save thousands of litres annually by fixing leaking taps and (3)____ rainwater during the (4)____ season.
qh:
गद्यांश को पढ़कर रिक्त स्थान (2) की पूर्ति कीजिए:
Water conservation has become an urgent (1)____ in both rural and urban areas. Farmers are adopting drip irrigation to (2)____ wastage while nourishing crops effectively. Similarly, households can save thousands of litres annually by fixing leaking taps and (3)____ rainwater during the (4)____ season.
e: Drip irrigation helps 'minimize' water wastage.

qe:
Read the passage and fill in blank (3):
Water conservation has become an urgent (1)____ in both rural and urban areas. Farmers are adopting drip irrigation to (2)____ wastage while nourishing crops effectively. Similarly, households can save thousands of litres annually by fixing leaking taps and (3)____ rainwater during the (4)____ season.
qh:
गद्यांश को पढ़कर रिक्त स्थान (3) की पूर्ति कीजिए:
Water conservation has become an urgent (1)____ in both rural and urban areas. Farmers are adopting drip irrigation to (2)____ wastage while nourishing crops effectively. Similarly, households can save thousands of litres annually by fixing leaking taps and (3)____ rainwater during the (4)____ season.
e: 'Harvesting rainwater' is the standard term for collecting and storing rainwater.

qe:
Read the passage and fill in blank (4):
Water conservation has become an urgent (1)____ in both rural and urban areas. Farmers are adopting drip irrigation to (2)____ wastage while nourishing crops effectively. Similarly, households can save thousands of litres annually by fixing leaking taps and (3)____ rainwater during the (4)____ season.
qh:
गद्यांश को पढ़कर रिक्त स्थान (4) की पूर्ति कीजिए:
Water conservation has become an urgent (1)____ in both rural and urban areas. Farmers are adopting drip irrigation to (2)____ wastage while nourishing crops effectively. Similarly, households can save thousands of litres annually by fixing leaking taps and (3)____ rainwater during the (4)____ season.
e: Rainwater is harvested during the 'monsoon' season.
